question: Should Twilio RCS become a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should this implementation ship as an external ClawHub/npm channel plugin?
rationale: The existing plugin API appears sufficient, VISION.md prefers optional and commercial integrations outside core, but RCS shares provider and phone-number semantics with the already bundled SMS channel; automation cannot decide whether that relationship clears the intentionally high bundling bar. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/main/VISION.md?utm_source=openai))

options.title: Publish externally
options.body: Move the RCS channel into its own maintained plugin repository and publish it through ClawHub/npm, keeping only separately justified generic SDK or route-registry changes in core.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept long-term core ownership, authorize the dependency graph, require durable receipt storage and upgrade-safe SMS route behavior, and obtain live Twilio proof before merge.

options.title: Split core hardening
options.body: Close or reshape this feature branch while extracting only the generic HTTP registration result and SMS collision fix into a narrow independently reviewed core change.

recommendation.title: Publish externally
recommendation.body: Move the RCS channel into its own maintained plugin repository and publish it through ClawHub/npm, keeping only separately justified generic SDK or route-registry changes in core.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the introduction and merge of the sibling bundled Twilio SMS channel, making this the closest owner for the bundling boundary.
